summary: Joe Lubar, 21, a DU junior, lost control on a double black diamond run at Copper Mountain and fell over a 50-foot cliff, suffering serious brain injuries and broken bones; taken to a Summit County hospital, then transferred to St. Anthony Central Hospital in Denver, where he died Feb 11.
